name: Name
title: Son of Caleb
summary: Naam was a son of Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, from the tribe of Judah. He is briefly mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of Caleb's lineage. Although little is known about his personal actions, he is part of the important lineage of Caleb, one of the twelve spies who remained faithful to God.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Caleb's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Naam is listed as a son of Caleb in the genealogical record of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's Inheritance in Judah
keyEvents.description: Naam belonged to the family of Caleb, who was granted land in Judah after the conquest of Canaan, linking Naam to this significant inheritance.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's Faithfulness as a Spy
keyEvents.description: Naam's father, Caleb, was one of the two spies who trusted God's promise to give the Israelites the Promised Land, a trait that characterized his entire lineage.

keyEvents.title: Caleb Takes Hebron
keyEvents.description: Caleb's conquest of the Hebron area laid the foundation for his family's settlement, including Naomi's place in the lineage.
